run_DDQN_CartPole: run a Double DQN experiment on the CartPole-v0 Gym environment with configurable hyperparameters
create_env_GymEnv: create a list of Gym environments wrapped with TimeLimit and return as GymEnv or GymEnvInf
create_agent_QAgent: create a QAgent instance with a given model and number of actions for DQN training
create_model_DQMLP: create a DQMLP neural network module with weight initialization for the observation space and action count
flatten_dict: flatten a nested dictionary or DictConfig into a single-level dictionary with slash-separated keys
